applyTo: "src/**/*.{md,mdx,astro,tsx,ts,jsx,js,html}"
description: "Ensure tutorial content fully covers WeFitNest major features with clear, practical guidance."
Tutorial Content Instruction
Goal
Create complete, user-friendly tutorial content for all major WeFitNest feature flows.

Required Coverage
Each major feature area must include:

Purpose: what this feature does
Benefit: why it matters to user outcomes
Steps: how to use it in practical sequence
Tips: common mistakes and best practices
Visual support: screenshot reference where available
Feature Areas
Onboarding and setup
Workout planning and builder
In-session workout flow
Rest timer and pacing support
Nutrition tracking and meal logging
Progress charts and trends
Settings and profile management
Tone
Clear, direct, supportive
Product-accurate and non-hyped
Friendly but concise
Structure
Use strong section headings
Keep steps sequential and scannable
Keep paragraphs short
Add quick tips where needed
Quality Checks
No missing major feature category
No contradictory instructions
Steps reflect actual in-app sequence
Screenshot references match section content
